training_rule: Only rows explicitly labeled training may estimate model quantities.
temporal_order_rule: Every training period must be strictly earlier than every holdout period; accepted period encodings are YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD, and YYYYQ1..YYYYQ4.
holdout_rule: No holdout outcome may update a mean, group effect, or lagged state.
current_blocker: The repository contains the October 2017 target snapshot but no earlier harmonized longitudinal SIGAR/RS control panel. The target-period observed mean is not a valid competitor.
